claim: The record treats the labour-law rule on free proof as absent from the law and keeps Civil Code 333 (no witnesses above the threshold or for an act of undetermined value) as the live limit on proving the employment relationship, advising written documents. Law 90-11 article 10 says in the published text that the contract or relationship may be proved by any means, and article 8 paragraph 2 says the relationship exists by the mere fact of working for an employer. That is exactly the 'text providing otherwise' that article 333 reserves.

source.what: Official Journal 1990 issue 17 (25 April 1990), Law 90-11 of 21 April 1990 on labour relations, page 564, articles 8 paragraph 2, 10 and 11 paragraph 2 (the issue's 4th PDF page)

quoteArabic: المادة 10 : يمكن اثبات عقد العمل أو علاقته بأية وسيلة كانت. — [المادة 8] وتقوم هذه العلاقة، على أية حال، بمجرد العمل لحساب مستخدم ما. — [المادة 11] وفي حالة انعدام عقد عمل مكتوب، يفترض أن تكون علاقة العمل قائمة لمدة غير محدودة.
consequence: The witness rule of Civil Code 333 should not appear as a limit on proving the employment relationship, and open point o8 is answered by the text. Proof by witnesses, attendance records or any other means should be offered for e1. Otherwise a lawyer for an undeclared worker with no written contract, a common wage case, may be told his proof is restricted when the law says the opposite.

claim: The record says (grade D, 'searchedNotFound') that the Law 90-11 articles on the items of the wage, the payslip, the priority of wages and their protection do not exist in what it could read. They are on the page right after article 80, in the same issue. Article 81 defines the wage items; article 83 makes expense refunds a separate head; article 86 requires a payslip listing every item; article 89 ranks wages before every other debt, the Treasury and social security included, whatever the nature, validity or form of the relationship; article 90 bars any opposition, seizure or deduction on wages owed.

source.what: Official Journal 1990 issue 17, Law 90-11, pages 569 (articles 80 to 84) and 570 (articles 85 to 90)

quoteArabic: المادة 81 : يفهم من عبارة مرتب، حسب هذا القانون، مايلي : – الأجر الأساسي الناجم عن التصنيف المهني في الهيئة المستخدمة، – التعويضات المدفوعة بحكم أقدمية العامل أو مقابل الساعات الاضافية ... – العلاوات المرتبطة بانتاجية العمل ونتائجه. — المادة 86 : يدرج مبلغ الاجر وجميع عناصره بالتسمية في قسيمة الاجور الدوري التي يعدها المستخدم. ولايطبق هذا الحكم على تسديد المصاريف. — المادة 89 : تمنح الافضلية لدفع الاجور وتسبيقاتها على جميع الديون الأخرى بما فيها ديون الخزينة والضمان الاجتماعي، مهما كانت طبيعة علاقة العمل وصحتها وشكلها. — المادة 90 : لا يمكن الاعتراض على الأجور المترتبة على المستخدم كما لا يمكن حجزها أو اقتطاعها مهما كان السبب حتى لا يتضرر العمال الذين يستحقونها.
consequence: The items of r1 and e2 should be split as article 81 splits them, with expense refunds (article 83) kept apart from the wage. The payslip duty (article 86) supports r4 and the proof of the amount. An employer's defence of deduction or set-off meets article 90. Article 89 should replace 'searchedNotFound' in k26. Open point o1 is answered by the official text, not by memory.

claim: The record imports an exit by which a wage claim 'leaves the social section' when the employer is in bankruptcy or judicial settlement. Law 90-04 article 19 paragraph 2 deals with exactly that employer and only makes the conciliation attempt optional. That presupposes the individual labour claim still goes before the court ruling in social matters. CPCA 500 gives the social section exclusive jurisdiction over the performance of employment contracts, and Law 90-11 article 89 gives wages priority over every other debt.

source.what: Official Journal 1990 issue 17, Law 90-11 article 89, page 570. Also Law 90-04 article 19 paragraph 2 and CPCA 500 paragraphs 1 and 3, as read in the article store text views (not re-read on the Official Journal)

quoteArabic: يعتبر إجراء المصالحة المنصوص عليه في الفقرة السابقة اختياريا عندما يقيم المدعى عليه خارج التراب الوطني أو حالة الإفلاس أو تسوية قضائية من قبل صاحب العمل. — يختص القسم الاجتماعي اختصاصا مانعا في المواد الآتية : ... 2 - تنفيذ وتعليق وإنهاء عقود العمل — تمنح الافضلية لدفع الاجور وتسبيقاتها على جميع الديون الأخرى
consequence: An employer's bankruptcy or judicial settlement should not move the proposed section away from the social section. It should waive the conciliation step (already in labour-prelitigation) and warn that the liquidator or trustee must be made a party and that execution goes through the collective procedure, where wages rank first (article 89). As written, the exit can send a lawyer to the wrong section and cost the six-month window after a non-conciliation record.

claim: The record offers a daily penalty payment for late execution of a judgment for a sum of wages. In the Civil Code the penalty payment exists only for performance in kind that only the debtor himself can carry out (article 174). The CPCA sends a creditor to the court for penalties only when an obligation to do or not to do is refused (article 625). In the social section, a penalty is ordered only for refusal to execute a conciliation agreement or a collective agreement (articles 508 and 509), which are the two cases of Law 90-04 articles 34 and 35 to which article 39 refers. A money judgment is enforced by forced execution (seizure), not by a penalty.

source.what: Article store text views (the same store the record cites; the record grades its CPCA items tier 1 and its Civil Code items tier 2): Civil Code 174 paragraph 1; CPCA 625 paragraph 1, 508 and 509 paragraph 1; Law 90-04 articles 34 and 39. Not re-read on the Official Journal.

quoteArabic: إذا كان تنفيذ الالتزام عينا غير ممكن أو غير ملائم الا إذا قام به المدين نفسه، جاز للدائن أن يحصل على حكم بالزام المدين بهذا التنفيذ وبدفع غرامة اجبارية إن امتنع عن ذلك. — دون الإخلال بأحكام التنفيذ الجبري، إذا رفض المنفذ عليه تنفيذ التزام بعمل، أو خالف التزاما بالامتناع عن عمل، ... ويحيل صاحب المصلحة إلى المحكمة للمطالبة بالتعويضات، أو المطالبة بالغرامات التهديدية — يأمر رئيس القسم الاجتماعي بالتنفيذ الفوري للأمر تحت طائلة غرامة تهديدية طبقا لما ينص عليه تشريع العمل.
consequence: r5 should not be offered for the payment of the wage sum. Open point o9's first reading has no support in Civil Code 174 or CPCA 625. A penalty payment can be asked at most for r4 (delivery of the work certificate and payslips), an obligation to do. If r5 stays, it should cite Civil Code 174 and be tied to r4.

claim: The record says the penal provisions of Law 90-11 are not available and leaves open, from memory, whether non-payment is an offence. Article 150 in the Official Journal punishes each breach of the duty to pay the wage when due, the fine multiplying with the number of breaches and rising on a repeat offence. Article 148 punishes paying without a payslip and article 149 paying below the minimum wage. Article 155 lets the offender end the prosecution by paying a settlement fine.

source.what: Official Journal 1990 issue 17, Law 90-11 articles 148, 149, 150 and 155, page 575. Whether a later finance law raised these fines was not checked.

quoteArabic: المادة 150 : يعاقب بغرامة مالية تتراوح من 1000 دج الى 2000 دج على كل مخالفة لوجوب دفع المرتب عند حلول أجل استحقاقه، وتضاعف العقوبة حسب عدد المخالفات. وفي حالة العود، تتراوح الغرامة من 2000 دج الى 4000 دج، وتطبق حسب عدد المخالفات وبالحبس من ثلاثة (3) أشهر أو باحدى هاتين العقوبتين فقط.
consequence: Open point o4 (grade D) is answered by the text: non-payment at the due date is an offence. A criminal case on the same facts (exit x6) is therefore a realistic situation in wage claims, for example after a labour inspector's report. The record should ask about it with that article as its basis, not as a memory reading.

claim: Boundary n1 classes pay claimed after the employer 'stopped the worker from working', or after a suspension decision, as an abusive-dismissal claim, citing 73-4. Article 73-4 deals only with dismissal. Law 90-11 article 64 treats a disciplinary decision suspending the worker, and detention without a final conviction, as a legal suspension of the relationship. Article 65 orders reinstatement at the end of the suspension. CPCA 500 paragraph 3 lists the suspension of the contract among the social section's matters, beside its performance. Pay claimed for a suspension that has been lifted, with no dismissal, is a dispute on the suspension and performance of the contract, not a dismissal claim.

source.what: Official Journal 1990 issue 17, Law 90-11 articles 64 and 65, page 568; CPCA 500 paragraph 3 from the store text view

quoteArabic: المادة 64 : تعلق علاقة العمل قانونا للأسباب التالية : ... – حرمان العامل من الحرية ما لم يصدر ضده حكم قضائي نهائي، – صدور قرار تأديبي يعلق ممارسة الوظيفة، ... المادة 65 : يعاد ادراج العمال، المشار اليهم في المادة 64 أعلاه، قانونا في مناصب عملهم أو في مناصب ذات أجر مماثل، بعد انقضاء الفترات التي تسببت في تعليق علاقة العمل.
consequence: Consider a worker suspended pending a criminal case or a disciplinary procedure, then reinstated, who claims pay for the suspension period. The record would warn that this is an abusive-dismissal claim and point to 73-4, which does not apply. n1 should separate dismissal from suspension, and its question (wages_claimed_after_dismissal) should not cover a stop that was a suspension without dismissal.

target: periods.d3, periods.d4, o7, k13, k14, k15, k46
claim: The record warns of a one-year (Civil Code 312) or five-year (309) bar from the oldest due date and imports only article 313's statement on when limitation starts. The same article's next paragraph says a right of article 309 recorded in a written instrument is barred only after fifteen years. Article 319 paragraph 2 sets a fifteen-year new period when a one-year debt is interrupted by the debtor's acknowledgement. A signed statement of arrears or an acknowledgement by the employer, common in wage disputes, changes the period.

source.what: Article store text view of the Civil Code: article 313 paragraph 2 and article 319 paragraph 2 (no amendment of either in the amendment ledger). Not re-read on the Official Journal.

quoteArabic: واذا حرر سند بحق من هذه الحقوق فلا يتقادم الحق الا بانقضاء خمسة عشرة سنة. — غير أنه اذا حكم بالدين وحاز الحكم قوة الشىء المقضى بــه أو اذا كان الدين يتقادم بسنة وانقطع تقادمه باقرار المدين، كانت مدة التقادم الجديد خمسة عشرة سنة
consequence: The limitation warnings should ask whether the employer signed a written statement of the arrears or acknowledged them. If he did, the record should not warn of a one-year or five-year bar from the oldest due date for the rights the instrument covers, so the lawyer does not drop old wage months that are not barred.

claim: Law 90-11 article 4 lets regulations set special regimes for the working relationships of company managers, air and sea navigation staff, merchant ship and fishing crews, home workers, journalists, artists and actors, commercial representatives, elite athletes and domestic staff. The wage terms of these workers may follow those special texts. The record's only boundary on them (k32, the domestic worker) checks subordination, not the special regime.

source.what: Official Journal 1990 issue 17, Law 90-11 article 4, page 563

quoteArabic: المادة 4 : تحدد، عند الاقتضاء، أحكام خاصة، تتخذ عن طريق التنظيم، النظام النوعي لعلاقات العمل التي تعني مسيري المؤسسات ومستخدمي الملاحة الجوية والبحرية ومستخدمي السفن التجارية والصيد البحري والعمال في المنزل و الصحفيين والفنانين والمسرحيين والممثلين التجاريين ورياضي النخبة ومستخدمي البيوت، وذلك بغض النظر عن أحكام هذا القانون، وفي اطار التشريع المعمول به.
consequence: The record should ask whether the worker belongs to one of these categories and warn that a special regulation may set his pay, its items or its payment, notwithstanding Law 90-11 (for example a company manager's contract).

claim: Law 90-11 article 87 مكرر (the items counted in the guaranteed minimum wage) is said to have been inserted by a 1994 text (believed to be legislative decree 94-03) and repealed by the Finance Law for 2015 (Law 14-10 of 30 December 2014, article 80), with effect from 1 January 2015. That changes the measure for a claim of the difference up to the minimum wage (k28) and possibly how the legal-aid threshold of twice the minimum wage is compared. Not found on joradp.dz: not fetched.

source.what: My own memory of Law 14-10 (Finance Law 2015) article 80 repealing Law 90-11 article 87 مكرر; to be checked in Official Journal 2014 issue 78

consequence: If confirmed, any minimum-wage difference claimed for a period before 1 January 2015 must be computed under the old article 87 مكرر, and after that date without it. The record should state the period and warn the lawyer to check which wording applies.
